title: State liability prohibited.
bodyText: The State is not liable to a participating financial institution for payment of the principal, the interest, or any late charges on a capital access loan made under this chapter.
bodyHtml: [§211D-11]  State liability prohibited.  The State is not liable to a participating financial institution for payment of the principal, the interest, or any late charges on a capital access loan made under this chapter. [L 2000, c 290, pt of §2]
